subject: SPANISH 2
pageTitle: Preterite vs Imperfect in Spanish: Rules and Examples
description: Preterite or imperfect? Learn when each Spanish past tense is used, the trigger words that give it away, and two worked examples.
caption: Preterite or imperfect? One rule and a list of trigger words end the guessing. Save this for your next Spanish quiz. Free Spanish 2 study guide at precisstudy.com/spanish-2 (no sign-up).

slides.title: PRETERITE = DONE
slides.note: If you can mark the start or end, use the preterite.

slides.title: IMPERFECT = BACKGROUND
lines: Age and time · eran las tres
slides.note: No clear start or end? Use the imperfect.

slides.title: EXAMPLE 1
steps: Ayer marks a specific, finished time.

slides.title: EXAMPLE 2
slides.problem: Cuando era niña, yo ___ (jugar) en el parque.
steps: Cuando era niña describes a repeated habit.

slides.title: WATCH OUT
slides.wrong: Cuando era niña, jugué todos los días
points: Todos los días points to a habit, so it needs the imperfect.
Some verbs change meaning: conocí = I met, conocía = I knew.
